source.title: [PCB] Review carrier V42 LED visibility and public inspection
source.body:
### Board or workstream
XEM8305 carrier V42 connecting the existing LDO board, separate from the standalone FPGA project.

### Owner, reviewer and scope
Publication owner: HowardWHSrun, prepared with Codex. Reviewer: TBD team member; no engineering approval is implied.
Branch: `publish/carrier-v42-review-2026-10-18`, starting from `presentation` commit `421019ddafe014c27ec7e279b14be09d598a525b`.
Scope: the dated public V42 package and shared overview V11. Original V41 and separate FPGA CAD remain preserved.

### Change and acceptance criteria
D601 moves from the XEM-facing side to the exposed underside at native (141,55 mm),90°, so all three rail LEDs can be inspected together in the nominal stack. Its indicator branch and local via clearances change; unrelated routing and placements remain exact. The public view includes native layout/schematic, a fresh V42 assembly model and a draggable illustration-spacing slider. Zero added spacing restores nominal attachment registration.

Native physical/silk/open/parity findings are zero. The 50 inherited library warnings and 210 inherited ERC findings remain documented. Independent preservation passes 22/22 checks, including 606 unchanged pin/net memberships. Public files omit supplier 3D payloads only and pass non-3D equivalence checks.

### Handoff
Published through PR #20, merged commit `3b53e44be60ee199c528644c4dfebadbaa4dde18`. Repository/Presentation/Pages checks passed; all 119 public files match; live mouse dragging changes board spacing.

This is a review snapshot, not engineering or fabrication approval. Team review, sourcing, factory stack/selective 13-via process and powered validation remain open. Next engineering reviewer/owner: TBD team member. The JLC draft remains V41; no order or payment is included. This issue remains open for engineering review.
